title: Legacy Law Offices acts on Functional & Innovative Foods proposed IPO
description: Functional and Innovative Foods Limited has filed a Draft Red Herring Prospectus before the SEBI for a book-built “Mainboard” offer for a fresh issue of 65,00,000 shares and an Offer for Sale for 25,00,000 shares, with an offer size of ₹90 crore+.Legacy Law Offices advised and acted for Functional and Innovative Foods, the Selling Shareholder (Senthil Kumar), and the Book Running Lead Manager (Beeline Capital Pvt Ltd) on this Mainboard IPO.The transaction team was led and supervised by
